verified_legacy_reference_files.legacy_export: window.MAHA_DATA = { PRODUCTS, CATEGORIES, GUIDE_ARTICLES, BLOG_ARTICLES, REVIEWS }
verified_legacy_reference_files.replacement: Remove embedded PRODUCTS dataset and legacy product access helpers after all consumers below are cut over. Keep unrelated localization/runtime code.

verified_legacy_reference_files.evidence: products() reads window.MAHA_DATA.PRODUCTS and falls back to getAllProducts(), then filters UUIDs.
verified_legacy_reference_files.replacement: Use canonical product/catalog RPC or canonical product lookup; do not build a UUID-filtered legacy cache.

verified_legacy_reference_files.evidence: Variant selection/detail/cart paths resolve the base product from MAHA_DATA.PRODUCTS.
verified_legacy_reference_files.replacement: Resolve the base product from the canonical product/variant path; variants remain canonical in product_variants.

verified_legacy_reference_files.evidence: Review summary/write-review paths resolve product presentation data from MAHA_DATA.PRODUCTS.
verified_legacy_reference_files.replacement: Use canonical product data or a local view model built from the canonical review/product response.

verified_legacy_reference_files.evidence: Wishlist hydrates, pushes and updates MAHA_DATA.PRODUCTS; product cards then resolve through the legacy array.
verified_legacy_reference_files.replacement: Render wishlist rows directly from canonical wishlist/product data. Do not mutate a global legacy catalog.

verified_legacy_reference_files.evidence: Checkout E2E currency fallback resolves product currency from MAHA_DATA.PRODUCTS when line currency is absent.
verified_legacy_reference_files.replacement: Require line/canonical product currency from the authoritative checkout/cart representation; avoid legacy fallback.

presentation_leaks.replacement: Use a canonical count or remove the statistic. Never hard-code production catalog size.

post_cutover_acceptance: No source file outside approved migration/delete set references MAHA_DATA.PRODUCTS.
00-localization.js no longer defines an embedded PRODUCTS array.
Variant/review/wishlist/checkout consumers resolve product data from canonical paths.
No feature copies canonical products into a global legacy cache.
Homepage does not claim a static catalog size.
Browser proof confirms Home, Shop, Search, Product, Compare, Routine, Cart and downstream role surfaces resolve the same canonical product identity.
